subject: Research · people-graph-360 · layout consistency pass (third pass — closed and verified)

body.summary: Completed a thorough audit of every responsive surface in /research/people-graph-360.html. Found six real bugs (five overflow risks, one defensive gap). All fixed. Rendered at 320 / 375 / 414 / 640 / 768 / 900 / 1024 / 1440px with Puppeteer. Zero horizontal scroll at any breakpoint. The compmat negative-margin breakout math is correct and was not touched.

verification.method: Puppeteer headless Chrome screenshots + document.body.scrollWidth vs window.innerWidth check at each breakpoint

compmat_breakout_verified.at_900px: matrix=828px centered, article=760px centered, matrix bleeds 34px each side within 900px viewport. Right edge at 864px. No overflow.
compmat_breakout_verified.at_1440px: matrix=1080px centered, article=760px centered. Right edge at 1260px. No overflow.
compmat_breakout_verified.at_768px: col-mid and col-read both resolve to 92vw=706.5px. Zero breakout. Table fills column width exactly.

verification.ascii_block_verified: scrollWidth=561px, clientWidth=343px at 375px. Block scrolls internally as designed. overflow-x: clip on body does not interfere with block's own scroll container.
verification.thead_hidden_verified: position=absolute, clip=rect(0,0,0,0), 1x1px. Visually hidden, screen-reader accessible. Geometric overflow of child elements is inside the clip context, not visible.

diagnosis.compmat_calc_verdict: Sound. col-mid = min(1080px, 92vw) — always ≤ 92vw < 100vw. Negative-margin centering within article is correct at all breakpoints. Left intact.
diagnosis.actual_culprits: sources-head flex row (no wrapping), long URLs in sbody (no overflow-wrap), ascii block (no max-width cap), article paragraphs and era-line paragraphs (no overflow-wrap as defensive measure).

bugs_found_and_fixed.symptom: No defensive overflow containment. Any future element overflowing the body would add a horizontal scrollbar.
bugs_found_and_fixed.fix: Added overflow-x: clip. Does not create a scroll container (unlike overflow-x: hidden). Verified: no content is meaningfully clipped — the only elements geometrically outside the viewport at narrow widths are (a) the visually-hidden thead in clip: rect(0,0,0,0) and (b) spans inside the .ascii block's own scroll container.

bugs_found_and_fixed.symptom: At narrow viewports, the flex row 'Working bibliography · 31 sources · 2026-05-22' + three legend pills (Verified / Reported / Inferred) had no flex-wrap and no mobile override. Combined width exceeded 320–414px viewports, causing horizontal scroll before the body overflow-x: clip was added.
bugs_found_and_fixed.fix: Added flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: baseline; gap: .6rem 1rem to baseline rule. Added .sources-head { flex-direction: column; gap: .5rem; } inside @media (max-width: 760px). At mobile: title wraps cleanly, legend pills stack on a new line.

bugs_found_and_fixed.symptom: Citation entries contain bare domain URLs (e.g. 'engineering.linkedin.com/teams/data/data-infrastructure/graph') without word-break. These expand the 1fr grid cell beyond its allotted width.
bugs_found_and_fixed.fix: Added overflow-wrap: break-word; word-break: break-word. URLs now wrap at narrow widths — visible in the 375px screenshot.

bugs_found_and_fixed.symptom: No overflow-wrap. Any unbreakable inline string in prose would expand the paragraph.

ASCII diagram (561px wide in monospace) inside a 343px container at 375px. The block had overflow-x: auto but no max-width. Without max-width, some browsers compute the block's width as the pre content's intrinsic width, potentially expanding the parent.
bugs_found_and_fixed.fix: Added max-width: 100%. The block is now capped at the article column width. The overflow-x: auto scroll still works within the block. Also added font-size: 10px at @media (max-width: 760px) to reduce the intrinsic pre width at mobile.

bugs_found_and_fixed.symptom: Era-line paragraphs inside 5.2rem left-padded list items had no overflow-wrap.

not_changed: mobile card-stack for competitor matrix (verified working)
body.o1_accessibility: The sources-head fix has a direct accessibility benefit: the legend pills (Verified / Reported / Inferred) were previously cropped behind horizontal overflow at 320–414px widths. They are now visible and keyboard-reachable at all viewport widths. Advances O-1.
